description: Differences between two texts: mode lines, words or chars; the added, removed and unchanged parts with counts, a similarity ratio (2 x unchanged / both texts' units), and a unified diff for lines. Body { a, b, mode }: lines and words up to 50 KB each, chars up to 20 KB each (capped for the Worker's CPU budget). Pure code using the diff package (BSD-3-Clause). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: text_diff
title: Text Diff
